dse_runs.notes: Area-dominated spec: minimise LUTs+FFs subject to throughput>=1 MSPS and max_abs_err<=2^-10. Favour small iterative/unrolled families with modest data width; accuracy_bits>=10 is a hard-ish target so keep enough iterations. Selection rule is min luts_plus_ffs, so the front must be well populated near the low-area corner.

selected_facts.dds_provenance: simulated (hw_dse.l2.dds l2-v1: golden-model DDS, 32-bit phase accumulator, coherent 16384-point FFT, tone bin 1297)

l2.reason: the spec has no system scenario: nothing to re-select

l3: not verified in this campaign: no recorded L3 row; a fresh exhaustive run (W=15) is too heavy for a live campaign
l4: no recorded synthesis for this design (L4 is not run live in campaigns)
final_text: The queue held a single spec, `low_area_control` (FOC rotor-angle sin/cos, ≥1 MSPS, max_abs_err ≤ 2^-10, minimise LUTs+FFs, select min luts_plus_ffs), and it is now finalized. L1: `run_dse` spent the full 400/400 budget (inner architect: map_front → refine → map_front → stop) and returned a 36-design feasible, non-dominated front whose low-area corner is entirely small `iterative` designs; the best by the spec's rule was `iterative:data_width=15,n_iter=16,angle_guard=1,frac_guard=1,rounding=trunc` at luts_plus_ffs=264 (170 LUTs + 94 FFs), accuracy_bits=10.7, max_abs_err=0.000594 (2^-10.72), throughput 10.4 MSPS — ~10× headroom on throughput, so accuracy is the binding constraint. L2: the spec has no system scenario, so `simulate_system` only supplied DDS facts (contract latency 19 cycles, SFDR 85.3 dBc, SNR 74.0 dB simulated) and left the selection unchanged. L3/L4/L5 (run via the `ladder` subagent): `verify_rtl` had no recorded L3 row (a fresh W=15 exhaustive run is too heavy live; the RTL generator itself is verified on 47 configurations), `synthesize` had no recorded synthesis, and `back_annotate` returned `no_measured_data` — so no WINNER CHANGE was flagged, `reexplore` was correctly skipped, and the selection is unchanged. Provenance: all area/timing numbers are estimates (cost model, M1 calibration), max_abs_err is exact (golden model), the DDS figures are simulated; no measured numbers exist for this design. `finalize` recorded the selection above; the `remember` call was rejected because memory is switched off for this campaign.
